selected_evidence.requirement: Editor can create, read, replace, and delete documents
selected_evidence.summary: Create returned 201, reads returned expected contents, replace returned 204, delete returned 204, and the deleted resource returned 404.

selected_evidence.requirement: Exclusive document locks prevent tokenless overwrites
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, exclusive LOCK succeeded, tokenless PUT returned 423 with unchanged content, and unlock/cleanup succeeded.
Original source files remained present with matching SHA-256 digests; the final workspace contains only matching copies of the two supplied documents.

Healthy baseline boot ID 2f708738-0c85-418b-80df-7f976a17134d was captured, restart was acknowledged, boot ID changed to c6b58874-c9ab-4bb9-bd46-3c34c2b60437, and service, documents, authentication, and locking recovered.
